guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: productcatalogservice shows the largest anomalies in the digest (latency-90 z=+309.74, mem +1118% from 1.06e7 to 1.29e8), and it is the shared downstream callee for recommendationservice, checkoutservice and frontendservice, whose latency rose afterward. Its cpu (+475%), diskio (0 to 8.4e9) and socket (+73%) also rose, so mem is the largest and most specific signal but cpu/disk could be secondary effects, and logs contain no errors to confirm.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or reschedule the productcatalogservice pods and raise/enforce their memory limits, then inspect for a memory leak or unbounded cache. This is non-destructive if done as a rolling restart with replicas available.
